answer: Each claim must plant a kernel grown only from its own verified jobs and pay 60 POA burned to sow it. At dawn the kernel must sprout in the sable-dark ledger soil, where peers count its growth rings against the public ledger line that fed it. A copied kernel rots at dawn — its rings match a foreign ledger line, the sprout withers, and the claim drops with its 60 POA burned. Cost doubles per claim from one operator, so 10 clones cost 61,380 POA; a kernel is rooted in its own ledger line and cannot be transplanted across identities.
